newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt group promises "Jihad" over Jerusalem.
newsitem.headline: Egypt group promises "Jihad" over Jerusalem.

text.p: A militant Egyptian Moslem group condemned a vote by the U.S. Congress that all Jerusalem should be Israel's capital and vowed a holy war against the United States and Israel to liberate the disputed city.

"The U.S. Congress displayed impudence such as there never was when it regarded Jerusalem the capital of the usurping Zionist entity (Israel) and allocated $100 million to move the American embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem," the Jihad Movement-Vanguards of Conquest said in a statement faxed to an international news agency on Friday.
The organisation is one of several dedicated to overthrowing Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak by violence and turning Egypt into a strict Islamic state.

"We are not surpised by the U.S. position that gives limitless support to the Zionist entity, for the enmity that the U.S. administration shows to Islam and Arabs is endless," the group said in the statement.

"But this will only increase our persistence to do battle with the U.S. and Zionist enemies in all arenas of Jihad until we liberate Jerusalem and all Moslem countries from U.S.-Zionist hegemony," it added.

Israel, which captured Arab East Jerusalem in 1967 and annexed it in a move unrecognised by the international community including the United States, welcomed the vote this month by the U.S. House of Representatives that called on President Bill Clinton to reaffirm Jerusalem must remain Israel's undivided capital.

The vote, which does not oblige the Clinton administration to act, came as Egypt struggled to resolve a peacemaking crisis between Israel and the PLO spurred by Israel beginning work in March on a 6,500-home Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
The Palestinians, who regard East Jerusalem as the capital of a future state, said the U.S. resolution was a declaration of war.
